classes.safe: The runtime applies the change (account keys), or the client that sent the turn does (device and runtime keys). The card offers Undo.
classes.confirm: Security, privacy or instructions. Applied only by the user's own tap, under their sign-in. Refused for runs an automation started.
classes.locked: Money or account. Never changed from a chat; the card links to Settings.
